notes.title: We are pleased to inform you about the release of our new VR game Hard Night!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25675900/23ba4040f0193d159e45a562dea6d73bcc2de7d2.png
Hello dear friends!
     We are pleased to inform you about the release of our new VR game Hard Night VR!
2021...
     After the defeat of the mutated CODIV-2020 virus, our world plunged into darkness. After infection with a virus, a person became aggressive, he only had animal instincts: eat and hunt for victims... For people... For you!
     You are one of the surviving zombie apocalypse. Use all your skills to stay alive and find your way to a military base. You can use more than 25 types of weapons, optical and collimator sights, a laser sight, a flashlight, silencers. Each weapon has a different damage, recoil, rate of fire.
     You will have to fight not only with zombies, but also with mutants.

notes.title: Release Information!
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for the immense support on our successful Greenlight, we couldn't be happier!

We'd like to thank all the people who voted "Yes" on our Greenlight page which finally got the 'go-ahead' to release to Steam. Woop-Woop!
Copter and Sky will be releasing between the 19th of July and 20th (depending on your timezone). We hope you will enjoy the game, and we'll keep you updated with any news we have to offer regarding our game!

Steam Achievements are releasing later in the future, so do not worry! We appologise for them not being ready at release; we'd like to make some additions and changes before adding the achievements.

Subscribe to the discussions and follow via the store page to be the first to see the news!

Thank you all!

- Bails and the FlyDreamDev team.
